Recruitment Overview

Embark on a prestigious career with the Indian Army's 124th JAG Entry Scheme. The government has announced recruitment for law graduates, offering 8 vacancies for the October 2026 batch. Online applications are open from January 27, 2026, to February 27, 2027. Eligible candidates can seize this opportunity to serve the nation as a Short Service Commission officer. Check the official website for detailed eligibility criteria and application process to join the Indian Army's esteemed JAG Entry Scheme.
